name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Optimization
definition: Stochastic Gradient Descent: Each step uses a randomly chosen camera rather than all of them at once, providing stochastic flavoring while computing the actual downhill direction.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Optimization renders 3D Gaussians to 2D images and updates parameters via distortion loss, uniquely linking gradient magnitudes to the dynamic addition and removal of primitives.
